# PicoSHA2

Unmodified `picosha2.h` from [okdshin/PicoSHA2](https://github.com/okdshin/PicoSHA2),
MIT licensed, copyright 2017 okdshin. Git file blob SHA:
`ef965e65232f20d1bda14c9b87165f6640024d3f`.
License: [PicoSHA2-LICENSE](PicoSHA2-LICENSE).

Used only by the non-macOS offline boot planner and its tests. The macOS hardware
path uses Apple's built-in CommonCrypto SHA256. No UA assets are included here.
